name: filters
title: Filters
description: A row of conditions you build and change in place, each read as a sentence: Status is Open, Amount more than 500, Due between 1 Oct – 14 Oct. Filter opens the menu of fields; a new token lands with its value editor open. The operator and the value are keys (a menu, a popover holding a field, a number field, a ticked list with search, or a calendar with Cancel and Apply); words turn on the drum; tokens arrive and leave with the rows' motion; Clear with two or more. Text, number, select, multiselect, boolean and date fields. `filterRows` applies the conditions to rows for a Table, `describeFilters` says them as one sentence.
base: Base UI Toolbar; Menu, Popover, Field, NumberField, CheckboxGroup, Calendar and Button
